name: PVT bulk growth window
claim: Tutorial bulk-growth window used as the reference band.

name: Standard 4H-SiC epitaxy window
claim: Tutorial epitaxy window used as the reference band.

name: Zoned showerhead + C/Si tuning
claim: Vertical reactor. Inner/middle/outer source and carrier flows cut thickness non-uniformity from 7.68% to 2.18%. Zone C/Si, dopant flow, and bottom-vs-sidewall heat cut doping non-uniformity from 14.62% to 3.87%.

name: Pre-H2/Ar anneal
claim: SiC surface anneal before oxide deposition. Aimed at interface passivation without nitrogen.

name: PECVD SiO2
claim: Deposited oxide after the hydrogen pretreatment.

name: CO2 anneal
claim: Post-deposition CO2 anneal to improve the deposited film.

name: Post-H2/Ar anneal
claim: Final hydrogen anneal. C–V shows a negative shift from positive fixed charge.

name: NO nitridation
claim: Conventional NO reference. Nitridation lowers Dit and adds near-interface hole traps.

name: NO nitridation
claim: Higher-temperature NO reference in the same split.

name: H2 trench-corner anneal
claim: High-temperature H2 anneal rounds the trench top corner to about 80 nm. IGSS at VGS = 22 V drops versus a sharp corner, on 6-inch and 8-inch flows.

name: Ar trench-corner anneal
claim: Ar anneal gives a larger top radius, about 138 nm, and tighter cross-wafer IGSS. CDE smooths the corner but changes the trench angle.

name: HCl-assisted p-type trench fill
claim: HCl suppresses mesa growth while the trench bottom keeps growing. Fill rate up to 10 μm/h and trenches as deep as 50 μm. Al incorporates more on (0001) than on {1-100} sidewalls.

name: Partial SJ MOSFET prototype
claim: Reported partial SJ MOSFET: about 7.8 kV and 17.8 mΩ·cm², SJ depth about 25 μm, roughly half the Ron,sp of the cited planar reference. Reversed p/n fill is their fix for Al sidewall doping.

name: Al and P channeling vs random
temperature_C: 400–600 (conventional hot implant); channeling also at room temperature
claim: Production Al/P implants are usually 400–600°C. Channeling reaches a similar profile in one step, can run at room temperature, and the abstract reports easier damage recovery after the activation anneal.

name: 1200 V pillars by channeled Al/P
species: Al up to 12 MeV; P up to 14 MeV
claim: Single epi layer, [0001] channeling. 1200 V pillars cited as 5–8 μm at 1×10^16–1×10^17 cm⁻³. SIMS shows >1×10^16 cm⁻³ out to about 6 μm. Multi-epi implant and p-type trench fill are named as higher-cost alternatives.

name: CO2 post-nitridation anneal
claim: Title-level process: CO2 anneal after nitridation, run in a hot-wall furnace intended to be production-compatible. Body text was not fully parameterized in this card.
